title: Hair Straightening
summary: Making curly or wavy hair straight, either temporarily with heat tools (flat iron) or longer-term with chemical treatments like keratin or rebonding.
key_points: Heat styling lasts until the next wash; chemical treatments last months
Use a heat protectant before flat-ironing
Too much heat or frequent chemical treatment can make hair dry and brittle
do: Keep the iron at a moderate temperature
dont: Don't straighten wet hair with a flat iron
